items.q: In the interatrial septum schematic, which opening lets fetal blood pass from right to left atrium?
items.exp: The foramen ovale shunts fetal blood right to left and closes after birth.
items.kp: The foramen ovale shunts fetal blood right to left and closes after birth.

x.key: The foramen ovale shunts fetal blood right to left and closes after birth.
x.pearl: The foramen ovale shunts fetal blood right to left and closes after birth.

items.q: In the heart shunt schematic, a PDA connects which two vessels?
items.exp: A patent ductus arteriosus connects the aorta to the pulmonary artery.
items.kp: A patent ductus arteriosus connects the aorta to the pulmonary artery.

x.key: A patent ductus arteriosus connects the aorta to the pulmonary artery.
x.pearl: A patent ductus arteriosus connects the aorta to the pulmonary artery.
